acquisitionNotes.htmlSingleCaution: The first ~100000 characters of an html-single page are site-wide product navigation. Reading only the start yields the GLOBAL chapter list, not the book's. Every retrieval below that mattered was read at an offset past the chrome.
acquisitionNotes.citationForm: Catalog and Field Guide citations use the paginated html/<book>/<chapter> form that readers land on. html-single is a verification surface, not a citation target.
acquisitionNotes.liveness: HEAD/liveness validation of every URL belongs to Tranche 2 docs-index authoring, run as an acquisition step, never from a test (runbook Phase 4, plan R4). curl cannot perform it here because of the 403 behaviour above.
